description: This file defines a Java interface `MqttConfig` that provides configuration settings for MQTT protocol, including a method to get the source buffer size and an enum `MqttConfigValue` holding default config values and paths.

classes.name: MqttConfig
classes.description: A Java interface that specifies configuration methods for MQTT, notably to retrieve source buffer size. Annotated as immutable for thread safety.

classes.name: MqttConfig.MqttConfigValue
classes.description: An enum implementing KnownConfigValue, holding configuration path and default values for MQTT settings, specifically the source buffer size.

methods.name: getSourceBufferSize
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of buffered messages for each MQTT source as an integer.
